Nature.title: Diverse binding poses of agonistic neurotoxins on human Na<sub>v</sub>1.6
Nature.summary: Nature, Published online: 10 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10661-x Structures of the distinct binding poses of three agonistic peptide toxins—bullet-ant-derived toxin δ-paraponeritoxin-Pc1a, cone snail ι-conotoxin RXIA and the globular β-scorpion toxin Cn2—on the human Nav1.6–β1 channel complex illustrate a diversity in binding poses and mechanisms of action.
